criteria.criterion: The no-wait promotion path persists `COMPLETED` before returning, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k no_wait_promotion_persists_completed_terminal_state`
The await-close promotion path still persists `AWAITING_PR_CLOSE`, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pr_close_workflow.py -k await_pr_close_path_persists_awaiting_pr_close`
The pull request close resolver ignores terminal rows, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_pr_events.py -k resolver_ignores_terminal_execution_rows`
The pull request close resolver prioritizes the waiting workflow, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_pr_events.py -k resolver_prioritizes_awaiting_pr_close_workflow`
The active run counter excludes completed executions, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_execution_persistence.py -k active_count_excludes_completed_executions`
Bug 'Persist a terminal execution state when a run does not await pull request close' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
